summary_en: Sandbox Co., Ltd. completed a tender offer for Digital Hearts Holdings shares from August 7 to September 24, 2026, acquiring 11,187,236 shares, exceeding the minimum threshold of 5,922,743 shares. Following settlement on September 30, 2026, Sandbox becomes the parent company with over 50% voting rights, while founder Eiichi Miyazawa transitions from largest shareholder to controlling shareholder (excluding parent company).
title_en: Notice Regarding the Results of Tender Offer for Shares of Digital Hearts Holdings Co., Ltd. by Sandbox Co., Ltd. and Changes in Parent Company, Principal Shareholder, Controlling Shareholder (Excluding Parent Company), and Major Shareholders
translation_en_brief:
Sandbox Co., Ltd. completed a tender offer for shares of Digital Hearts Holdings Co., Ltd. from August 7, 2026 through September 24, 2026. The offer received applications for 11,187,236 shares, which exceeds the minimum threshold of 5,922,743 shares set in advance, and thus the tender offer was successfully completed. Sandbox acquired all tendered shares.

Following settlement on September 30, 2026, Sandbox will own sufficient shares to hold more than 50% of voting rights in Digital Hearts Holdings and will become the company's parent company and principal shareholder. Sandbox was established on July 13, 2026, and is 100% owned by Eiichi Miyazawa, who is also Digital Hearts Holdings' representative director and chairman.

As a result of the transaction, Eiichi Miyazawa, the previous largest shareholder holding 9,425,633 shares of Digital Hearts Holdings, will cease to be the principal shareholder. However, Miyazawa will remain a controlling shareholder (excluding parent company) when his shares are combined with those held by Sandbox, of which he is the sole owner. Miyazawa submitted 500,000 of his shares to the tender offer.
